connector.name: Purify Security Feeds
connector.registryDescription: Query CISA KEV / EPSS vulnerability feeds with full per-record provenance and auditable versions
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image purify-feeds-mcp:1.0.1. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the eason4kim-rocket account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PURIFY_API_KEY
env.description: API key for the public feeds gateway (issued manually during the pilot — open a GitHub issue to request one)

env.name: PURIFY_API_URL
env.description: Feeds API base URL (defaults to the public gateway https://feeds.verifly.pro/feeds-api)
